claims.head: A brick wall against a revolving door
claims.body: The Sabres keep shots away, but the Flyers give up plenty. Buffalo is near the top of the league for shot suppression, and Philadelphia is one of the worst. Expect the Flyers to give up the bigger pile of shots.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 20% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 45%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Owen Tippett is day to day (upper-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Cam York is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Nick Seeler has taken his spot beside Jamie Drysdale.
Travis Konecny is on injured reserve and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-six forward.
Oliver Bonk was added to the roster on Oct 12 and has played beside Travis Sanheim.
Jack Studnicka was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Michael Bunting and Noel Acciari.
David Jiříček has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 44% of the team’s power-play time in 7 games, up from 2% last season.
Rasmus Dahlin is out (upper body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Olen Zellweger has taken his spot beside Mattias Samuelsson.
Jason Zucker is on injured reserve (abdomen surgery) and has not played this season.
Dennis Gilbert was added to the roster on Oct 14.
Zach Metsa has started killing penalties: on the ice for 48% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 7% last season.
Josh Norris has started killing penalties: on the ice for 27% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 1% last season.

BUF.head: The Sabres should have the upper hand
BUF.body: Even though Buffalo will be without Dahlin, the Sabres have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Flyers can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

PHI.head: The Flyers face a real test
PHI.body: Even though Buffalo will be without Dahlin, the Sabres have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Flyers’ best way through is a penalty kill that holds up.
